about: Jacksonville's roster: every player the club controls (the active roster, the reserve lists and the practice squad), his position, his status and the club's current medical communication on his availability, and the players who left the club's control this season with how control ended. Transcribed with rebuild step 3b (October 19, 2026) from the roster page as it stood at the close of 2014 Week 5 (October 5, 2014), every value as written there; the page is now built from this record. An availability value keeps its link to the medical record that communicated it, relative to the roster page. Two values were later reworded in football terms (Marcel Jensen's availability and Jeris Pendleton's departure); each keeps its original words in as_written, which is never rendered.
